## Delivered against the row

- **Server (migration):** `chat_op_register_message(message)` (a reader only, no label, refuses deleted/system rows), `chat_message_refs(ids)` (chip + card facts for readable messages; deleted = `deleted`, no words/author; nothing for the rest), `chat_conversations_for_item(type, id)` (the mentions half: lines for conversations you read about items you can open), `chat__body_refs` + `chat__link_mentions` (send and edit leave one `mentions` row per conversation and item, origin `ref`), `chat_op_send` / `chat_op_edit` from live bodies (CV-12's reopen kept), `entities_op_ensure` from its live body (chat items registered only by a reader, a message never with a label; server-only grant as on prod).
- **moduo-mcp:** `linksInScope` / `assertLinkInScope` drop links with a chat end, whatever the key's Chat access.
- **References** (`spine/references/chat.ts`, kinds `message` / `conversation`): chip "author · first words" (author's avatar), card author · conversation · time + two lines; conversation chip glyph · name, card topic · people · last message; "Deleted message"; "Private item"; ⌘-open lands on the conversation at the message. Icons `chat_channel` / `chat_private` / `chat_dm` / `chat_message`.
- **Make a task:** T / ⋯ → the capture as Task with the words, a removable "From: Sofia's message in Acme" chip (`CaptureRequest.source`, kind `message`, `resolve` = register), Inbox (linked project is CV-13's). "Became a task: ○ … · Today" under the message (below the replies line, corner glyph, round 1 frame 3), live chip; the task's Linked shows the message card.
- **"Mentioned in Acme · Oct 12"** lines in the task Linked, the EntityHub (notes, events, email) and contacts/companies; the `mentions` rows stay out of link cards (rollup) and out of Recently linked.
- **Typed handle chip** (`composer/handle-chip.tsx` over RF-1's plugin): `MOD-142` + a boundary → live task chip; Esc right after puts the text back (⌘Z too).
- **⌘7 Message capture** (`chat/capture-type.tsx`): no default destination, picker focused (recent conversations, then people without a DM), a person opens a DM, the page's "From:" item goes in as a card, ⏎ sends, toast "Sent to … · Open · Undo" (8 s, Undo deletes).

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **"Mentioned in" counts only items in the registry the sender can open**; people, teams, days, tags, conversations and messages leave none · a line must never point at something the sender couldn't see · rejected: registering unknown ids.
- **Refs inside code don't count**, fenced blocks and single-backtick spans only (multi-backtick spans aren't stripped) · rejected: forking the 100-line block walker.
- **Mention links write no activity row** · quiet history, as the spec wants the line itself to be the signal · rejected: `links_op_create` (needs links edit; logs activity).
- **The line's date is the first mention** in that conversation.
- **"Became a task" reads `spawned-from` links** for the messages on screen, again after a capture made here (1.5 s and 6.5 s) and on window focus; others see it on load/focus, not instantly · no realtime on `entity_links` (publishing it is a workspace-wide change) · its task chip is live through References. A just-made item shows at once and goes after 6 s if the server never shows the link (chip removed, template, failed register). Only tasks are added locally.
- **Message chip = "author · first words" with the author's avatar**; the card's overline is author · conversation, the time trailing.
- **Message capture:** destinations are DMs and channels you're in (not public ones you never joined); people already in a 1:1 DM appear as that DM; the From item is appended alone on a line (a card). The Open button is sonner's secondary action.
- **Esc undoes a handle chip only if nothing changed since** (text compared), replacing the chip with the typed handle.
- **The DM name in a message card reads "Direct message"** (the read returns no member list).

## Gotchas (area: supabase / ui)

- The local stack's function ACLs come from a prod snapshot with Supabase's default privileges: `proacl` locally shows `anon`/`authenticated` EXECUTE that prod doesn't have. Take grants from `~/.cache/moduo/supabase-snapshot/public.sql` or the last repo migration.
- The worktree guard refuses `psql` with `-c` strings it can't parse and loops over variables: write the SQL to a file and `psql -f … -o …`; put shared scratch files in a subfolder (other builders share the session scratchpad).
- A ref inline needs a real uuid: `serializeBlocks` drops `{t:'ref'}` with a malformed id, and two paragraphs serialize with one newline.

## Manual checklist (step → expect → surface)

- [ ] Press T on someone's message → capture as Task with its words and "From: Sofia's message in Acme" → ⏎ → "Became a task: ○ …" under it → Chat
- [ ] Open that task → Linked shows the message card → Tasks
- [ ] Type `MOD-142 ` → chip; Esc → back to text → Chat
- [ ] Send a message with a task chip → the task's Linked shows "Mentioned in <channel> · <day>" → Tasks
- [ ] ⌘⇧K → type menu → Message (⌘7) → pick a person → write → ⏎ → "Sent to … · Open · Undo"; Undo removes it → anywhere
- [ ] As someone not in a private channel: a message link from it reads "Private item" → anywhere
